notes.title: Patchnotes update v0.3.4
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your feedback so far! We will keep pushing updates during the event so please share all your thoughts about the game, we really appreciated it :)

[h3]v0.3.4[/h3]

[list]
[*] We have checked and removed a lot of instances where some grass and spikes were in the same tile making the spikes very hard to see.
[*] We have fixed the placement of some foreground elements in the Learn section so these don't obstruct the view when jumping is required.
[*] Colliders of the world were reviewed and fine-tuned, there were some weird slope and walls that now have correct collision shapes.
[*] Fixed a soft-lock bug in the Kaizo zone where if you got to the second checkpoint and the Crusher killed you just there it's position didn't reset, making you respawn inside the Crusher killing you over and over again.
[/list]

The Spoonman Games team.

notes.title: Patchnotes update v0.3.3
notes.notes:
Some changes have been done to help you better go through the Kaizo zone :)

[h3]v0.3.3[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the Electrical Lines sprites so their On and Off states are way easier to differentiate.
[*] Updated a part on the Kaizo Zone where a small jump needed to be performed, the jump is still required but the gap to go through is a little bigger to make it easier to go by.
[*] FIxed a bug in the Start zone where some rocks didn't reset properly upon dying, You could collide with those rocks, even break them but not seem them. This is now fixed.
[/list]

The Spoonman Games team.

notes.title: Patchnotes update v0.3.2
notes.notes:
We have made a quick update to address some small issues with the Linked Mask Demo.

[h3]v0.3.2[/h3]
[list]
[*]The game now starts by default in full-screen and with vSync on. If you already opened the game before this fix you will have to start a Stage, open the pause menu, go to options and there change the resolution manually. These options are saved for when you reopen the game.
[*]A few checkpoints, tiles, and cameras have been fine tunned to look better.
[*]Additional gameplay elements have been added to the Kaizo zone.
[/list]

The Spoonman Games team.

notes.title: New Demo release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Just recently we have noticed that Steam has delayed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gamefestival]The Steam Game Festival Summer Edition[/url] to June 16th, 10 AM PDT. We are part of this event so the demo itself won't be available until the Festival starts.

I hope you can keep up with us for another week while we wait for the event to begin! In the meantime, we have worked some updates for the demo so at least you will have more content to enjoy :)

The Spoonman Games Team.
